B-Daman Bakugaiden V - Final Mega Tune.name: B B-Daman Bakugaiden V: Final Mega Tune
B-Daman Bakugaiden V - Final Mega Tune.summary: B B-Daman Bakugaiden V: Final Mega Tune is a Japanese only role playing game for the Game Boy Color.

David Beckham Soccer.name: David Beckham Soccer
David Beckham Soccer.summary: David Beckham Soccer is a football sports video game for PlayStation, PlayStation 2 and Xbox, Game Boy Advance and Game Boy Color. All formats were developed and published by Rage Software Limited, apart from the Game Boy versions which were developed by Yoyo Entertainment.

Hamster Club 2.name: Hamster Club 2
Hamster Club 2.summary: The second hamster breeding simulation game. In addition to the familiar "Shigecchi", cute new characters are appearing one after another. A new mini-game has been added to the new story, and it is full of fun and cuteness. Comes with a mascot doll as a first-time limited benefit.

Medarot 3 - Kabuto Version.name: Medarot 3 Kabuto Version
Medarot 3 - Kabuto Version.summary:
Medarot 3 was released in 2000 for the Game Boy Color. It was released in two versions: Kabuto and Kuwagata.

The game follows Ikki Tenryou and his friends in the town of Omikuji. After Ikki robottles with the Screws, everyone's Medarotch data is suddenly deleted by an unknown figure.

Medarot 3 introduced various new gameplay aspects, including Medachange and Medalias.

Pokemon Card GB.name: Pokémon Trading Card Game
Pokemon Card GB.summary: Your goal in life is to become a Pokemon Card Master. In order to do that, you must pick a deck from three starter packs of cards based on Charmander, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur and travel to the eight card clubs and defeat their leaders. Along the way, you will challenge many players to collect new cards and the helpful Professor Mason will aid you by giving you cards as well. While becoming a card master is a laudable accomplishment, the real goal of the game is to collect all of the cards over 200 in all. If you want to collect all of the cards, you must play human opponents in the Pop mode to get a chance to earn rare cards. All of the complexity of the real-world game has been captured here. Play Pokemon Trading Card Game and become a Pokemon Card Master.
